<h>Hymnus</h>
<c>I</c>esu Salvátor sǽculi,
Redémptis ope súbveni:
Et pia Dei Génitrix,
Salútem posce míseris.

<h>C</h>œtus omnes angélici,
Patriarchárum cúnei,
Et Prophetárum mérita
Nobis precéntur véniam.

<h>B</h>aptísta Christi prǽvius,
Et Cláviger æthéreus,
Cum céteris Apóstolis,
Nos solvant nexu críminis.

<h>C</h>horus sacrátus Mártyrum,
Conféssio Sacerdótum,
Et virginális cástitas
Nos a peccátis ábluant.

<h>M</h>onachórum suffrágia,
Omnésque cives cǽlici
Annuant votis súpplicum,
Et vitæ poscant prǽmium.

<h>L</h>aus, honor, virtus, glória
Deo Patri, et Fílio,
Sancto simul Paráclito,
In sæculórum sǽcula.
Amen.
b.b681a8a1b6:
<h>Hymn</h>
<c>G</c>iver of life, eternal Lord!
thy own redeemed defend;
Mother of grace! thy children save,
And help them to the end.

<h>Y</h>e thousand thousand angel hosts!
Assist us in our need;
Ye patriarchs! with the prophet choir!
For our forgiveness plead.

<h>F</h>orerunner blest! and thou who still
Dost heaven's dread keys retain!
Ye glorious Apostles all!
Unloose our guilty chain.

<h>A</h>rmy of martyrs! holy priests
In beautiful array!
Ye happy troops of virgins chaste!
Wash all our stains away.

<h>A</h>ll ye who high above the stars
In heavenly glory reign!
May we through your prevailing prayers
Unto your joys attain.

<h>P</h>raise, honour, to the Father be,
Praise to his only Son;
Praise, Holy Paraclete, to thee,
While endless ages run.
Amen.

<h>Lectio 1</h>
<r>Ex Sermóne Rabani vel Maxími Tarentíni</r>
<c>L</c>égimus in ecclesiásticis históriis quod sanctus Bonifátius Papa quartus a Phoca Cæsare impetrávit donári Ecclésiæ templum Romæ, quod ab antíquis Pántheon vocabátur. In hoc ígitur, elimináta omni spurcítia, fecit ecclésiam sanctæ Dei Genetrícis atque ómnium Mártyrum, ut exclúsa multitúdine dæmonum, plebs univérsa in cápite Kalendárum novémbrium, ad ecclésiam in honórem ómnium Sanctórum consecrátam conveníret. Crescénte ígitur religióne christiána, decrétum est ut per orbem terrárum memória ómnium Sanctórum ea die haberétur: ut, quod humána fragílitas in solemnitátibus eórum minus plene peregísset, in hac sancta observatióne solverétur. <r>℣.</r> Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
<r>℟.</r> As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

<r>℣.</r> Show us, O Lord, thy mercy.
<r>℟.</r> And grant us thy salvation.

<r>℣.</r> The Lord be with you.
<r>℟.</r> And with thy spirit.
<c>D</c>irect, we beseech thee, O Lord, our actions by thy holy inspiration, and carry them on by thy gracious assistance: that every prayer and work of ours may always begin from thee, and by thee be happily ended.
Through Christ our Lord.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.

<r>℣.</r> Our help is ✠ in the name of the Lord,
<r>℟.</r> Who made heaven and earth.

<r>℣.</r> May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.
